claim: Offline ABL metadata preparation makes the pinned GS101 DTB selectable by the Pixel 6 bootloader without altering hardware nodes.
oracle: Two variants carry exact a0/b0 soc_id values, Omarchy diagnostic bootargs, /ect and DPM overlay targets; all original hardware properties and reserved memory remain byte-identical.

user_journey.scenario: Boot a guarded diagnostic image on slot B after recovering USB; a failed trial retains known recovery images.
user_journey.expected: ABL can select a DTB and apply its policy overlay; kernel boot remains separately tested.

gitnexus: Unavailable; direct inspection of existing Oriole image builder and known booted DT metadata.
ast: Independent flat-tree comparison permits only enumerated metadata additions.

unit.red: Pinned compiled DTB has no root soc_id and no DPM symbols; bootargs is empty.
unit.green: Actual R6 DTB passes both silicon-ID variants, exact diagnostic bootargs, DPM targets, unchanged hardware tree, existing-output rejection and wrong-input rejection.

boundaries: compiled DTB -> overlay application -> two verified variants -> guarded boot image -> real ABL
evidence: dtc and fdtoverlay successfully produce ABL variants from the actual compiled R6 DTB; binary-property comparison passes.
Initial overlay chosen-node warning corrected by targeting /chosen in its own fragment; final compilation has zero stderr warnings.

dtschema 2026.9 checked the actual R6 base and both ABL variants. Base has 690 diagnostics; each variant retains those and adds one untyped root soc_id diagnostic. Exit code 0 did not mean clean validation. See gs101-schema-r1-evidence.json.
Earlier known-booted Oriole tree provides soc_id, chosen bootargs, ect and four DPM labels; GPU/panel state is intentionally not copied.
limitations: DT metadata preparation cannot prove ABL acceptance, watchdog handoff, USB recovery or hardware drivers.
The whole-tree schema gate remains failing: inherited vendor bindings and the added soc_id metadata need review. No hardware fields were changed to silence diagnostics.
exit_gate: Exact offline tree checks, guarded initramfs/module integration and recovery readiness before a slot-B hardware trial.
